caption: The drawing displays three fireplace tools arranged vertically, each depicted with detailed outlines and shading. The items include, from left to right: a pair of fireplace tongs with elongated, black handles and small, circular gripping ends; a central tool resembling a fireplace fork or poker with a similarly long black shaft, and a prominent, ornate gold-colored handle featuring a rounded knob at the top and decorative segments; and to the far right, a coal shovel with a broad, curved black blade that tapers into a handle with the same ornate, gold-colored design as the fork. Each tool has a gold-colored wall mount attached toward the top of their handles, consisting of a decorative finial and a bracket. The background is an off-white color, bordered by a fine black line, and the artist's name, "HANS KORSCH," is written in the bottom left corner. A black scale in inches is located in the bottom right corner.
title: Fireplace Set
